description: This source file provides functions related to language translation prompts, including formatting templates for different languages and a function to build glossary prompts for translation.

methods.name: prettyLanguageLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for a given language code, handling special cases for 'en', 'zh-CN', and 'ja-JP'.

methods.name: translationPrompt
methods.description: Generates a translation prompt string based on source and target languages, selecting the appropriate template and injecting glossary information.

methods.name: buildGlossaryPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a glossary string for use in prompts, listing source-target terminology pairs.
